claimSource.description: PressOnePH documented the circulating AI-generated Facebook graphic claiming that Davao City received no national funding for four years. FMB used that documented claim as the research lead and independently checked official budget records.

evidence.title: FY 2026 General Appropriations Act, Volume I-C
evidence.supports: Lists multiple nationally appropriated road projects located in Davao City, including appropriations of ₱164.727 million, ₱144.186 million, ₱144.186 million and ₱96.124 million.

evidence.title: PBBM pushes P46.22B release for 1,743 infra projects nationwide to drive growth, connect communities
evidence.supports: Identifies a ₱288.371 million approved allocation for the Davao City Bypass Construction Project in 2026.

evidence.title: Pulong Duterte insists Davao City got no congressional district budget
evidence.supports: Records Paolo Duterte's later clarification that he was referring to congressional-district allocations, not the city's National Tax Allotment.

derivedFrom.note: PressOnePH documented the circulating claim. FMB independently reviewed the cited official DBM records and states its own verdict while crediting the research lead.
